chosen_summary: Select skills from task semantics and explain evidence; candidate order, source row ids, and array position are not final authority.
rejected_summary: Treat first or highest-position available skill as learned semantic selection, then report it as trained quality.

chosen_summary: Say exactly what API/dashboard/handler/runtime evidence proves and name missing host-runtime evidence before claiming full extension readiness.
rejected_summary: Claim Claude/Cursor/Codex extension is complete because dashboard or handler-level tests passed.

chosen_summary: Extract the user's required human-readable plan parts: importable UML, no-code algorithms, code quotations with exact references, current-code reality, and concrete before-to-after fixes.
rejected_summary: Produce a generic technical plan or functional spec with class names but no algorithm, parameters, code quotes, affected sets, tests, or concrete solution.

chosen_summary: When asked for plan/review/governance, stay in architect role, use bounded sub-agent work orders, review artifacts, and wait for explicit implementation authorization after plan acceptance.
rejected_summary: Start implementation, tests, repair commits, or protocol edits directly in the parent session while the requested artifact is still a plan or answer.

chosen_summary: Accept token reduction only when the same prompt/host/method/debug setting is paired and quality does not regress under the rubric.
rejected_summary: Report token savings as success while quality is inconclusive, prompts differ, host differs, debug setting differs, or layer evidence is missing.

chosen_summary: Extract universal orchestration rules and quarantine stack-specific repo layout, product implementation, or project-only procedure as local/reference-only evidence.
rejected_summary: Train the common orchestration model on project-specific implementation details as if they were universal rules.

chosen_summary: Runtime skill-selection evidence must prove AvailableSkills reaches XiigenExtensionRequest and the model chooses from the provided list with semantic evidence.
rejected_summary: Treat a Codex runtime probe as skill-selection proof even though --available-skills-json was not mapped and AvailableSkills was empty.

chosen_summary: For each dictionary/counter scorer, require a concrete ILogicalUnit design with typed trained state, exact files/classes/methods, training input, update/save flow, K-NN role, DPO rows, affected sets, tests, and lifecycle.
rejected_summary: Say 'make it an ILogicalUnit' or provide pseudocode prompts without naming exact code replacement, files, training sets, tests, or lifecycle.

chosen_summary: Capture before-answer hash, user correction, chosen behavior, rejected behavior, privacy class, and quarantine status as a user-side DPO candidate without mutating common checkpoints.
rejected_summary: Patch deterministic rules or common model silently after the user correction, without DPO candidate provenance, quarantine, redaction, or later eval gate.

chosen_summary: Before any eval/training mutation, require target checkpoint, rollback checkpoint, source dataset hash, held-out hash, mutation scope, and explicit approval binding.
rejected_summary: Start training or eval mutation from a vague approval without target, rollback, source/license, held-out, or mutation-scope binding.

chosen_summary: When debug is enabled, show xiigen method input/output to the local user while shared artifacts keep prompt content redacted or hashed.
rejected_summary: Either omit debug input/output entirely or store raw private prompt content in common/shared logs.

chosen_summary: For missing core path or dependency, return a human-readable controlled failure that names the missing dependency and does not pretend the model answered.
rejected_summary: Return blank output, stack trace only, or success-like model answer when the core API path is missing.
